aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.subtitle: Build healthier habits, together.
aboutPage.p1: Vointy.life has been developed to improve the wellbeing, healthy lifestyles and shared activities of employees in companies and communities. The goal is that employees enjoy their work and stay fit for work by making use of the Vointy.life app.
aboutPage.p2: The service has been designed and developed by Wellthyforce Oy, a Finnish start-up. The company is owned and financed by private entrepreneurs.
aboutPage.value1Description: Employee wellbeing is at the centre of everything we build.
aboutPage.value2Description: Shared activities and healthy habits bring teams and communities closer.
aboutPage.value3Description: Designed and developed by Wellthyforce Oy, owned and financed by private entrepreneurs.

careersPage.title: Careers
careersPage.subtitle: Vointy.life is expanding globally and operating in numerous languages.
careersPage.intro: We are looking for the following professionals to join our team:
careersPage.salesText: We offer independent salespeople a commission-based agreement to sell Vointy.life services to companies. We pay a 35% commission on realized sales. Ask more at contact@vointy.life
careersPage.partnerText: We are looking for partnership partners for sales who operate in the field of improving employees' work ability. Vointy.life provides a great additional opportunity to sell other occupational wellbeing services to customers. Ask more at contact@vointy.life
